# multipass_images (Data Source)

Returns the list of images and blueprints reported by `multipass find`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "multipass_images" "lts" {
  alias = "lts"
}

output "lts_image_name" {
  value = data.multipass_images.lts.images[0].name
}
```


All arguments are optional and can be combined.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias filter (matches any alias).
- `kind` (String) Filter by kind (`image` or `blueprint`).
- `name` (String) Exact image name filter.
- `query` (String) Case-insensitive substring filter applied to names and descriptions.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String) List of alias strings.
- `description` (String) Same as release for images; blueprint descriptions otherwise.
- `kind` (String) `image` or `blueprint`.
- `name` (String) Canonical image name.
- `os` (String) Operating system label.
- `release` (String) Human-friendly release description.
- `remote` (String) Remote channel (empty for default).
- `version` (String) Image version tag.
